explanation: States that a SIC-POVM exists in dimension 68, using the standard definition (d² normalized vectors with pairwise |⟨φ,ψ⟩|² = 1/(d+1)). Numerical solutions are known for all d ≤ 196, but per Bengtsson–Grassl (arXiv:2512.13201) exact solutions are only claimed for d ≤ 57, so a rigorous existence proof in dimension 68 is plausibly still open. I did not find a source claiming an exact solution for this dimension. The statement is faithful.
